propositions: Agents file bugs outside epic hierarchy during execution but the direct-children close gate cannot detect them when they are actual deliverable defects caused by epic changes.
DET caused_by floor must block epic close when any open/in_progress bug has a caused_by edge targeting the epic or its descendant, with deterministic short-circuit before LLM verification.

Candidate filter identifies open/in_progress bugs created after the epic's first in_progress transition OR linked to the epic subtree (any relation, both directions), capped at 32 with overflow tally.

Haiku relevance screen performs forced-choice classification (A: defect in deliverable, B: pre-existing/adjacent, C: unrelated) per candidate using model-class config and shared cache, forwarding A-verdicts as compact evidence block to verifier.

Verifier blocks only undispositioned deliverable-defects via store-grounded disposition check: supersedes/duplicates link OR reasoned pre-existence/supersession prose (bare 'out of scope' does not satisfy).
Screen output rides registered epic_bug_screen_verdict schema with normalizing validator; screen failure degrades open; sidecar records full tally including overflow count.
